caption: The drawing depicts a metallic architectural element, specifically a decorative gutter or downspout leader head. It is rendered in shades of greenish-gray with areas of brownish and rusty patina. The top front face of the object features the numbers "1843" in a reddish-brown color. Below the date, a panel contains the profile of a bird, likely an eagle, in a lighter, muted color that contrasts with the background. One of the angled sides displays a raised five-pointed star. The spout extends downward from the center bottom of the object, showing weathering and rust at the mouth. The background is a plain, light tan with subtle shading and discoloration. The artist's name, STANLEY MAZUR, is printed in small uppercase letters in the lower right corner.
title: Conductor Head
